name: Bases Freeze Panes
changes: New command "What Pro adds": read each Pro feature and try it on a sample table.
The Pro section of the settings and the Pro notice also open "What Pro adds".
tip: Turn on 'Freeze Markdown and Dataview tables' to pin headers in ordinary note tables.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Freeze Panes is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.

related.name: Bases Filter Switches
related.blurb: Turn saved Bases filters on or off with switches.

related.name: Bases Link Graph
related.blurb: See the notes and links from a filtered base as a graph.

related.name: PDF Cover Cards
related.blurb: Show the first PDF page as a cover in your base.
